newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean futures traders under tax probe.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean futures traders under tax probe.

text.p: South Korean tax authorities are investigating local futures traders for tax evasion, traders said on Tuesday.
"Officials seem to be trying to figure out whether local futures traders evade taxes by using complicated futures trades," a trader with a major bullion house said.

A statement, issued by the Seoul tax office and obtained by Reuters, said the futures traders had been asked to submit documents by April 30. The requested documents include details on futures trades, cash settlements and payment approvals by authorities.
All of Korea's futures transactions are conducted on overseas exchanges, as Korea has no futures exchange of its own.
